description: This file defines the class pScatter used for drawing scatter charts, including scale preparation, scatter plot, line, and spline charts, as well as labels, thresholds, thresholds areas, and legends within the charting library implementation.

classes.name: pScatter
classes.description: Class to draw scatter charts, lines, splines, labels, thresholds, areas, legends, and best-fit lines within the charting library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes pChartObject and pDataObject references.

methods.name: drawScatterPlotChart
methods.description: Draws a scatter plot chart using configured data points and styles.

methods.name: drawScatterLineChart
methods.description: Draws a line connecting scatter points.

methods.name: drawScatterSplineChart
methods.description: Draws a spline (smooth curve) through scatter data points.

methods.name: getPosArray
methods.description: Calculates the scaled position array for a set of values along a specific axis.

methods.name: drawScatterLegend
methods.description: Draws the legend box for scatter series at specified coordinates.

methods.name: getScatterLegendSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size of the scatter legend box based on series descriptions.

methods.name: writeScatterLabel
methods.description: Draws labels for specific scatter points.

methods.name: drawScatterThreshold
methods.description: Draws a horizontal or vertical threshold line at a given value.

methods.name: drawScatterThresholdArea
methods.description: Draws a rectangular area corresponding to thresholded data ranges.

methods.name: drawScatterBestFit
methods.description: Draws the line of best fit (regression line) through scatter points.
